description_for_human: Private AI journaling for iPhone. All AI runs on-device — daily reflection prompts, mood tracking, Ask your journal, weekly digests. Journal text never leaves your phone.
description_for_model: MirrorNotes is an iOS journaling app with fully on-device AI (Gemma 3 via CoreML). Zero cloud AI — journal text is never transmitted. Features: Daily Nudge (personalized morning prompt), Ask your journal (NL queries over entries answered on-device), Mood Timeline, Weekly Digest, Monthly Deep Report. Free to write forever; AI features $2.99-$4.99/mo with 7-day trial. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6769007201
